  const input: ExtractInput = { bytes: await (await import("node:fs/promises")).readFile("text/fake_text.txt"), config: { disableOcr: true, forceOcr: true }, filename: "fake_text.txt", kind: ExtractInputKind.Bytes, mimeType: "text/plain" };
